dnipro-ua.reason: Real photo collage: church, riverside skyline, and bridge over the Dnipro river — clearly conveys the city.

dodoma-tz.reason: Real photo of Nyerere Square with government/office buildings and minaret visible behind — shows city context, not an isolated object.

doetinchem.reason: Real photo of a pedestrianized shopping street with the Catharinakerk tower — good city/town street view.

dombivali.reason: Real photo, but it's a single isolated building (Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation HQ) with no surrounding city/street context — fails the city-view-not-isolated-building bar. Also ambiguous: this civic HQ serves the twin-city Kalyan-Dombivli area, not identifiably Dombivali specifically.

donetsk-ua.reason: Real hazy aerial photo of Donetsk's downtown high-rises and apartment blocks — clear city skyline view.

dongguan-cn.reason: Real photo collage: hilltop skyline view, temple complex, bridge, and garden pavilion — solid representation of the city.

donghe.reason: Real photo but does not show the place — just a plane landing near a generic lakeside restaurant/pavilion with reeds, no identifiable skyline, landmark, or signage tying it to Donghe. Could be anywhere.

dongshi.reason: Real photo of the Dongshi fishing harbor with boats and waterfront buildings — accurately represents the fishing port the town is known for.

douala-cm.reason: Real dusk photo of the Douala skyline with high-rises and radio tower — shows the city.

dundee.reason: Real photo collage of Tay Rail Bridge, V&A Dundee museum, Broughty Castle, McManus Galleries, RRS Discovery ship, and a tower — strong multi-landmark city representation.

dunhua.reason: Real photo of an industrial/downtown street with factory buildings, smokestack, and road — shows a city view.

dursley.reason: Real photo of the historic Market House, the well-known symbol of this small market town — acceptable for a town (not a major city) rather than requiring a skyline.

dusseldorf-de.reason: Real panoramic photo of the Rhine riverside with the Rheinturm TV tower and skyline — clear city view.

enugu-ng.reason: Real photo, but it's dominated by a close-up roundabout statue/monument with only a hazy, minimal background (some hills, faint low buildings) — reads as an isolated monument shot rather than a city view.

erzurum.reason: Real photo collage: mosque, fountain plaza, downtown shopping street with traffic, monument, cable car, and memorial towers — thorough city representation.

essen-de.reason: Real street-level photo of Essen Hauptbahnhof with traffic, buses, and pedestrians — shows an active city scene, not just an isolated building.

faisalabad-pk.reason: Real photo of the Clock Tower (Ghanta Ghar) at the hub of the famous 8-bazaar market, surrounded by dense street life, shops, and traffic — effectively the city center, not an isolated monument.

foshan-cn.reason: Real photo of the riverside skyline with stadium and towers — clear city view.

frankfurt-am-main-de.reason: Real photo of Frankfurt's old town in the foreground with the skyscraper skyline behind — excellent city view.

fukuoka-jp.reason: Real aerial photo of the Fukuoka coastline, dome stadium, and dense city buildings — strong city view.

fuyang-cn.reason: Real photo of a downtown pedestrian walkway/overpass with buildings, shops, and people — shows an urban street scene.

fuzhou.reason: Real night photo of the illuminated Fuzhou CBD skyline along the river — clear city view.

ganzhou-cn.reason: Real photo of a city street flanked by apartment towers — shows an urban street view.

gaziantep-tr.reason: Real night aerial photo of the illuminated downtown tower skyline — clear city view.

goyang-si.reason: Real photo of a dense commercial street packed with shop signage and traffic — genuine city street view (though generic, lacking a distinct skyline landmark).
